entry.title: InCad 0.11.4: Every plane of a row can be edited; work features on 3D Line points; a 3D Line hides like a sketch
entry.content:
Added

  • Double-click a work plane (in the browser or in the view) to open its dialog; with a row of planes, each plane has its own offset and Turn rings, and a click on another plane of the row moves the dialog there.
  • Point fields offer a 3D Line's ends and the points it passes through, and work points: a plane square to the line at its start for a sketch to sweep or loft along it; the work feature follows the line when it changes.
  • Angle around edge and Normal to edge at point take an origin or work axis as the edge.

Fixed

  • Only the first plane of a row could be turned; Planes typed on another plane of the row made a second row; a row's first plane switched to another method kept the others tied to it.
  • A 3D Line (and a sketch's Text) could not be hidden; now Hide / Show and Show All / Hide All Sketches treat it as a sketch, and a 3D Line a Sweep uses hides.
  • Work features: corners clicked again in Edit stay tied to the part; Midpoint of edge lies halfway along arcs and curves; Edge meets plane and Two edges meet refuse what does not meet; Angle about an origin axis works.
  • Picks that cannot work (parallel planes, three points in a line, the same point twice, a circle for an axis, another Solid's face) are refused in plain words.
